name: lebanese-blonde
about: Thievery Corporation - Lebanese Blonde (The Mirror Conspiracy, 2000), official audio YouTube zNhHhtJ1reM; Songsterr tab 2330317 ('More Precise': the sitar hook as overdriven guitar, the A-E drone as clean guitar, bass, a breakbeat with maracas). v1 setup on chirp's sitar, a clean guitar drone, finger bass, break-kit and a djembe-kit shaker; the vocal (Pam Bricker), horns and strings are not in the tab yet. Tempo 92.008 BPM fitted to the drum stem's eighth-note hats (5.4 ms rms, flat over the song); bar 1 at 0.138 s (the sitar's first note; the bass's m5 entry lands on the record's 10.57 s low-band jump).
